name: Prazepam
summary: An anti-anxiety medicine in the benzodiazepine family, used for short-term treatment of anxiety. It is less sedating at first than some others and has a long, steady calming effect.
description: Prazepam is an anti-anxiety medicine in the benzodiazepine family. It is used for short-term treatment of anxiety disorders and anxiety symptoms. Compared with some other benzodiazepines, it is less sedating at first but has a long, steady calming effect because the body turns it into another active substance. It is generally kept for cases where a long-lasting effect is helpful. Prazepam is not widely available in the United States but is prescribed in some European and other countries.
